🏮🌙 **Welcome to the Midnight Bazaar — the workspace's official street food HQ.** 🌙🏮

Yes, this old channel has been revived. The Q3 project is done; the appetite never was. Sophie and Mateo called it: all those coffee-and-pizza conversations scattered around our channels deserve one roof, so here it is.

**The bazaar remembers its origins:**

It started the way these things do — with a broken machine. Łukasz noticed the 4th-floor espresso making weird noises; Mateo admitted it's been on borrowed time for two months. Sophie answered with the only correct move in coffee: a French press at her desk and a standing offer to run extraction masterclasses — because, in her words, "caffeine is just a proxy for focus." Aisha signed up for the masterclass immediately, mostly to avoid "caffeine-induced bugs."

From there we had the Valencia run: 3 large pizzas, garlic knots (non-negotiable, per Sophie), a side ramen bowl for Aisha, and a lunch coordinated with all the rigor of a "distributed consensus problem."

Even the work channels leak food. Kenji warned us that crunch weeks are when "anyone else forgets to eat real food," surviving a whole sprint on vending machine snacks — and floated a team food rotation. Olena proved the rotation concept live in #general with her grandma's Ukrainian honey cake. That's the energy we're bringing under this awning.

**House rules of the bazaar:**
• Drop street food finds, late-night vendors, and lunch plans here — no more pie-ordering archaeology in #random.
• Bring recipes, techniques, and masterclass offers. French press, ramen, honey cake — everything on the menu.
• If the espresso machine dies again, that's a bazaar emergency. We rally here.

The market is open. What are you bringing to the stall? 🍜🍕☕
